title: SEC4: run_session_io name is ambiguous
description: In lifecycle.rs, the three session-entry functions are named run_plain_session, run_session_post_starttls, and run_session_io. The first two names say what they do; run_session_io does not. It handles the implicit-TLS (NNTPS) path only — connections where TLS was accepted by the caller before this function is invoked. A clearer name would be run_nntps_session or run_implicit_tls_session. The current name forces readers to inspect the body to understand when it is called.
